channel.title: Japan AI Monitor
channel.description: AI monitoring of Japan's political, economic and security developments

item.title: Kyoto prosecutors appeal acquittal over 2013 murder of Ohsho president
item.description: In its Oct. 16 ruling, Kyoto District Court found that reasonable doubt remained over whether Yukio Tanaka was the shooter.

item.title: Ex-Takenaka manager admits breach of trust over Osaka Expo
item.description: The former manager acknowledged having a subcontractor submit inflated bills for construction work related to last year's World Exposition.

item.title: Japan’s Sumitomo Mitsui Trust Bank buys stake in Indian PE firm
item.description: The investment underscores Japanese institutional investor interest in Indian companies across financial services, manufacturing and real estate.

item.title: LDP, JIP and DPP plan to cut Lower House seats, ending standoff
item.description: The three parties plan to introduce and pass a related bill by the end of the current session to cut 31 proportional representation seats.

item.title: Swiss franc, Japanese yen Rise as DeepSeek News Boosts Safe Havens
item.description: The Yen and Swiss Franc were stronger against the dollar as investors sought safe havens after Chinese start-up DeepSeek’s new AI model hit U.S. tech stocks.
